traditional.enunciado: Which type of security program is violated when a group of employees enters a building using the ID badge of only one person?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Using another person’s badge/ID to enter a facility violates physical access control. IDS/network authorization/user awareness are different security program elements.

traditional.enunciado: What is a characteristic of RSA?
alternativas: It uses preshared keys for encryption.
It is an asymmetric encryption algorithm.
It is a symmetric decryption algorithm.
It requires both sides to have identical keys for encryption.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: RSA is a public-key (asymmetric) algorithm with different public/private keys. Preshared identical keys describe symmetric cryptography, not RSA.

traditional.enunciado: What is an enhancement implemented in WPA3?
alternativas: employs PKI and RADIUS to identify access points
defends against deauthentication and disassociation attacks
traditional.explicacao_profunda: WPA3 requires Protected Management Frames, helping defend against deauth/disassociation spoofing, and adds SAE. TKIP is legacy WPA, not a WPA3 enhancement.

traditional.enunciado: Which action must be taken when password protection is implemented?
alternativas: Use less than eight characters in length when passwords are complex.
Include special characters and make passwords as long as allowe
Share passwords with senior IT management to ensure proper oversight.
Store passwords as contacts on a mobile device with single-factor authentication.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Strong passwords should be long and include complexity (special characters, mixed case, numbers). Short passwords, sharing, or storing in contacts weaken security.

traditional.enunciado: An engineer must configure R1 for a new user account. The account must meet these requirements:• It must be configured in the local database.• The username is engineer2.• It must use the strongest password congurable.Which command must the engineer configure on the router?
alternativas: R1(config)# username engineer2 privilege 1 password 7 test2021
R1(config)# username engineer2 algorithm-type scrypt secret test2021
traditional.explicacao_profunda: algorithm-type scrypt secret uses a strong hashing algorithm for local username secrets. Type 7 password is weak/reversible; type 4 is deprecated/broken; malformed secret 5 syntax is wrong.

ticket.sintoma: Chamado #11420 — Conta local engineer2 deve usar o hash mais forte disponível no IOS moderno. Senha type 7 foi rejeitada pela auditoria.
ticket.cli_output:
R1# show running-config | include username
username engineer2 privilege 1 password 7 08324D400E1C03161E

R1# show aaa users
! local user present, weak reversible password
alternativas: Recriar com username engineer2 algorithm-type scrypt secret <senha>.
Manter password 7; é o mais forte no IOS.
secret 4 com hash MD5 legado é recomendado atualmente.
secret 5 password <hash> é a sintaxe documentada preferida.
ticket.explicacao_profunda: algorithm-type scrypt secret aplica hashing forte ao segredo local. Type 7 é reversível. Type 4 está deprecado/inseguro. Sintaxe secret 5 password é inválida/errada.

traditional.enunciado: What is a characteristic of RSA?
alternativas: It uses preshared keys for encryption.
It is a private-key encryption algorithm.
It requires both sides to have identical keys.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: RSA is a public-key cryptosystem (asymmetric). It does not use a single shared private key on both sides like symmetric crypto.

traditional.enunciado: What is used as a solution for protecting an individual network endpoint from attack?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Endpoint protection (antivirus/EDR) defends the individual host. WLC/router/DNA Center are infrastructure/management, not host AV.

traditional.enunciado: Which security method is used to prevent man-in-the-middle attacks?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Anti-replay (sequence checks, typically in IPsec) prevents capture-and-replay MITM-style abuse of packets. AAA authN/authZ/accounting are related but not the anti-replay mechanism named here.

traditional.enunciado: Which cipher is supported for wireless encryption only with the WPA2 standard?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: WPA2 data confidentiality uses AES-CCMP. RC4/TKIP are older; SHA is hashing, not the WLAN cipher suite name here.

traditional.enunciado: Which WPA mode uses PSK authentication?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: WPA Personal mode uses a PSK. Enterprise uses 802.1X/EAP. Local/Client are not WPA mode names for PSK.

traditional.enunciado: To improve corporate security, an organization is planning to implement badge authentication to limit access to the data center. Which element ofa security program is being deployed?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Badge readers limiting facility entry are physical access control. Awareness/training are people programs; vulnerability verification is assessment.

traditional.enunciado: Which benefit does Cisco DNA Center provide over traditional campus management?
alternativas: Cisco DNA Center automates HTTPS for secure web access, and traditional campus management uses HTTP.
Cisco DNA Center leverages SNMPv3 for encrypted management, and traditional campus management uses SNMPv2.
Cisco DNA Center leverages APIs, and traditional campus management requires manual data gathering.
Cisco DNA Center automates SSH access for encrypted entry, and SSH is absent from traditional campus management.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: DNA Center is API-driven and intent-based versus traditional campus managers that are often CLI/SNMP device-centric. That extensibility/automation is the key contrast.

traditional.enunciado: How does Chef configuration management enforce a required device configuration?
alternativas: The Chef Infra Server uses its configured cookbook to push the required configuration to the remote device requesting updates.
The installed agent on the device connects to the Chef Infra Server and pulls its required configuration from the cookbook.
The Chef Infra Server uses its configured cookbook to alert each remote device when it is time for the device to pull a new configuration.
The installed agent on the device queries the Chef Infra Server and the server responds by pushing the configuration from the cookbook.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Chef agents (clients) pull/query the Chef Infra Server for cookbooks/recipes and enforce desired state. It is agent-based pull, not purely push-only from server without client participation.

traditional.enunciado: What is the PUT method within HTTP?
alternativas: It replaces data at the destination.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: HTTP PUT replaces/updates the target resource representation and is idempotent. It is not read-only (GET) and not primarily for rendering a website.

traditional.enunciado: Which advantage does the network assurance capability of Cisco DNA Center provide over traditional campus management?
alternativas: Cisco DNA Center leverages YANG and NETCONF to assess the status of fabric and nonfabric devices, and traditional campus managementuses CLI exclusively.
Cisco DNA Center handfifiles management tasks at the controller to reduce the load on infrastructure devices, and traditional campusmanagement uses the data backbone.
Cisco DNA Center automatically compares security postures among network devices, and traditional campus management needs manualcomparisons.
Cisco DNA Center correlates information from different management protocols to obtain insights, and traditional campus managementrequires manual analysis.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: DNA Center assurance correlates multi-source telemetry for health insights beyond siloed traditional tools. The advantage is integrated assurance analytics.

traditional.enunciado: What is the purpose of a southbound API in a controller-based networking architecture?
alternativas: facilitates communication between the controller and the applications
allows application developers to interact with the network
integrates a controller with other automation and orchestration tools
facilitates communication between the controller and the networking hardware
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Southbound APIs connect the controller to network devices for programming. Northbound faces applications/orchestration.

traditional.enunciado: Which function generally performed by a traditional network device is replaced by a software-defined controller?
alternativas: building route tabfifiles and updating the forwarding table
encapsulation and decapsulation of packets in a data-link frame
changing the source or destination address during NAT operations
encryption and decryption for VPN link processing
traditional.explicacao_profunda: SDN controllers take over control-plane duties such as computing routes and updating forwarding state. Encapsulation, NAT rewrite, and VPN crypto remain data-plane/device functions.

traditional.enunciado: What describes a northbound REST API for SDN?
alternativas: network-element-facing interface for GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE methods
application-facing interface for SNMP GET requests
application-facing interface for GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE methods
network-element-facing interface for the control and data planes
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Northbound REST APIs face applications using HTTP methods GET/POST/PUT/DELETE. Southbound faces network elements; SNMP is not the NB REST model.

traditional.enunciado: When is the PUT method used within HTTP?
alternativas: when a nonidempotent operation is needed
when a read-only operation is required
traditional.explicacao_profunda: PUT is used to create/replace/update a resource representation (idempotent update). It is not for read-only display and is not the nonidempotent method (that is typically POST).

traditional.enunciado: What is the advantage of separating the control plane from the data plane within an SDN network?
alternativas: limits data queries to the control plane
offloads the creation of virtual machines to the data plane
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Separating control and data planes centralizes decisions and simplifies device operations/complexity for policy and automation. It does not offload VM creation onto the data plane.

traditional.enunciado: What is a function of a northbound API in an SDN environment?
alternativas: It relies on global provisioning and configuration.
It upgrades software and restores fifiles.
It supports distributed processing for configuration.
It provides orchestration and network automation services.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Northbound APIs enable orchestration and network automation applications above the controller. Device software restore paths are not the NB definition.

traditional.enunciado: What is an Ansible inventory?
alternativas: unit of Python code to be executed within Ansible
file that defines the target devices upon Which commands and tasks are executed
device with Ansible installed that manages target devices
collection of actions to perform on target devices, expressed in YAML format
traditional.explicacao_profunda: An Ansible inventory is the file (or source) listing target hosts/groups. Playbooks are actions; modules/tasks are units of work; the control node runs Ansible.

traditional.enunciado: What is a function of a northbound API?
alternativas: It relies on global provisioning and configuration.
It upgrades software and restores fifiles.
It supports distributed processing for configuration.
It provides a path between an SDN controller and network applications.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Northbound APIs support centralized/global provisioning and automation interfaces for apps. The path controller→devices is southbound.

traditional.enunciado: A network architect is considering whether to implement Cisco DNA Center to deploy devices on a new network. The organization is focused onreducing the time it currently takes to deploy devices in a traditional campus design. For which reason would Cisco DNA Center be moreappropriate than traditional management options?
alternativas: Cisco DNA Center supports deployment with a single pane of glass.
Cisco DNA Center provides zero-touch provisioning to third-party devices.
Cisco DNA Center reduces the need for analytics on third-party access points and devices.
Cisco DNA Center minimizes the level of syslog output when reporting on Cisco devices.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: DNA Center enables zero-touch/automated provisioning at scale for new sites, a major advantage over pure box-by-box traditional rollout.

traditional.enunciado: In a cloud-computing environment, What is rapid elasticity?
alternativas: control and monitoring or resource consumption by the tenant
automatic adjustment of capacity based on need
pooling resources in a multitenant model based on need
self-service of computing resources by the tenant
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Rapid elasticity is automatic scale-out/in of cloud capacity with demand. Multitenancy, measured service, and self-service are other NIST cloud characteristics.

traditional.enunciado: Which interface enabfiles communication between a program on the controller and a program on the networking device?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Southbound interface is controller↔network device programs/agents. Northbound is controller↔applications.

traditional.enunciado: Which interface type enabfiles an application running on a client to send data over an IP network to a server?
alternativas: Representational State Transfer application programming interface
traditional.explicacao_profunda: An API lets a client application send/receive data to a service over the network. NBI/SBI are SDN-specific directions; REST is one API style.

traditional.enunciado: What does traffic shaping do?
alternativas: It sets QoS attributes within a packet
It modifies the QoS attributes of a packet
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Traffic shaping queues excess traffic and meters the send rate to a limit. Marking/classification set or identify QoS attributes rather than queue for rate conformance.

traditional.enunciado: What is the benefit of using private IPv4 addressing?
alternativas: to enable secure connectivity over the Internet
to shield internal network devices from external access
to provide reliable connectivity between like devices
to be routable over an external network
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Private IPv4 helps shield internal hosts from direct external addressing/exposure (with perimeter controls). It is not Internet-routable without NAT.

traditional.enunciado: Two switches have been implemented and all interfaces are at the default configuration level. A trunk link must be implemented between twoswitches with these requirements:• using an industry-standard trunking protocol• permitting VLANs 1-10 and denying other VLANsHow must the interconnecting ports be configured?
alternativas:
switchport mode dynamic
channel-protocol lacp
switchport trunk allowed vlan 1-10

switchport mode trunk
switchport trunk allowed vlan 1-10
switchport trunk native vlan 11

switchport mode trunk
switchport trunk encapsulation dot1q
switchport trunk allowed vlan 1-10

switchport mode dynamic desirable
channel-group 1 mode desirable
switchport trunk encapsulation isl
switchport trunk allowed vlan except 11-4094
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Industry-standard trunking is 802.1Q (dot1q) with mode trunk and allowed VLANs. ISL is Cisco-proprietary; dynamic-only without encapsulation may be incomplete on some platforms; LACP is EtherChannel not trunk protocol.

ticket.sintoma: Chamado #11445 — Trunk 802.1Q entre SW1–SW2 deve permitir só VLANs 1–10; defaults ainda em DTP.
ticket.cli_output:
SW1# show interfaces gi1/0/1 switchport
Administrative Mode: dynamic auto
Operational Mode: static access
Administrative Trunking Encapsulation: negotiate

SW1# show running-config interface gi1/0/1
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/1
! sem trunk/dot1q/allowed
alternativas: switchport mode trunk, encapsulation dot1q (se exigido), allowed vlan 1-10.
ticket.explicacao_profunda: Padrão da indústria é 802.1Q. mode trunk + encapsulation dot1q + allowed 1-10 cumpre. ISL é proprietário; LACP é EtherChannel.

traditional.enunciado: A network administrator wants the syslog server to filter incoming messages into different files based on their importance. Which filtering criteriamust be used?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Syslog severity level is commonly used to filter messages into different files/destinations. Facility categorizes source; PID/body are less typical primary file-split keys.

traditional.enunciado: Which interface or port on the WLC is the default for in-band device administration and communications between the controller and accesspoints?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: WLC management interface is the default in-band admin and CAPWAP-related management path. Service port is OOB; console is serial; virtual is for mobility/webauth.

traditional.enunciado: What is the recommended switch load-balancing mode for Cisco WLCs?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Cisco recommends source-destination IP load-balancing on neighboring switches for WLC LAG for better distribution of CAPWAP flows.

traditional.enunciado: What must be considered when using 802.11a?
alternativas: It is chosen over 802.11b when a lower-cost solution is necessary
It is susceptible to interference from 2.4 GHz devices such as microwave ovens
It is compatible with 802.11b- and 802.11g-compliant wireless devices
It is used in place of 802.11b/g when many nonoverlapping channels are required
traditional.explicacao_profunda: 802.11a (5 GHz) offers many nonoverlapping channels versus crowded 2.4 GHz b/g. It is not cheaper than b, not 2.4 GHz interference prone the same way, and not backward compatible with b/g RF.

traditional.enunciado: What is represented by the word "LB20" within this JSON schema?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: In JSON, a quoted string after a colon is a value. Keys are left-hand names; objects/arrays are structures.

traditional.enunciado: What is represented beginning with line 1 and ending with line 5 within this JSON schema?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: A brace-delimited structure spanning multiple lines is a JSON object (set of key/value pairs).

traditional.enunciado: What is represented by the word "IDS" within this JSON schema?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: A left-hand property name such as "IDS" is a JSON key.

traditional.enunciado: What is represented in line 4 within this JSON schema?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: A nested {} structure on a line is a JSON object value.

traditional.enunciado: What is represented by the word "port" within this JSON schema?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: The property name "port" is a key in the object.

traditional.enunciado: What provides connection redundancy, increased bandwidth, and load sharing between a wireless LAN controller and a Layer 2 switch?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: LAG/EtherChannel between WLC and switch provides redundancy, more bandwidth, and load sharing. FHRP is gateway redundancy; trunking is VLAN tagging.

traditional.enunciado: Which interface is used to send traffic to the destination network?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Based on the routing/CEF exhibit (not shown in text bank), traffic to the destination uses the interface indicated by the longest-match route—here F0/12 per the keyed answer.

traditional.enunciado: What is the purpose of an SSID?
alternativas: It identifies an individual access point on a WLAN.
It differentiates traffic entering access points.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: SSID names a WLAN for client discovery/association. It is not primarily a single-AP hardware ID or a security mechanism by itself.

traditional.enunciado: What describes the functionality of southbound APIs?
alternativas: They enable communication between the controller and the network device.
They communicate with the management plane.
They use HTTP messages to communicate.
They convey information from the controller to the SDN applications.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Southbound APIs enable controller communication with network devices to program forwarding. Northbound faces apps; HTTP alone does not define SB.

traditional.enunciado: Which command must be entered so that the default gateway is automatically distributed when DHCP is configured on a router?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: In a DHCP pool, default-router distributes the default gateway to clients. ip helper-address is relay; dns-server is DNS option; default-gateway is host/router command elsewhere.

ticket.sintoma: Chamado #11459 — Pool DHCP ok, clientes sem gateway. Servidor IOS local.
ticket.cli_output:
R1# show running-config | section dhcp
ip dhcp pool LAN
 network 10.10.10.0 255.255.255.0
 dns-server 8.8.8.8
! sem default-router

R1# show ip dhcp binding
! clientes com IP, sem default gateway no lease options
alternativas: ip helper-address no mesmo pool define o gateway.
dns-server já envia o default gateway.
default-gateway global no roteador preenche a opção DHCP automaticamente.
ticket.explicacao_profunda: Opção de gateway no IOS DHCP pool é default-router. helper-address é relay. dns-server só DNS.

traditional.enunciado: Which 802.11 management frame type is sent when a client roams between access points on the same SSID?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: When roaming between APs on the same ESS/SSID, the client sends a Reassociation Request. Association is initial; probe discovers; authentication is security exchange.

traditional.enunciado: What is a functionality of the control plane in the network?
alternativas: It looks up an egress interface in the forwarding information base.
It forwards traffic to the next hop.
It exchanges topology information with other routers.
It provides CLI access to the network device.
traditional.explicacao_profunda: Control plane exchanges routing/topology information (e.g., OSPF/EIGRP/BGP). Forwarding lookups and next-hop send are data plane; CLI is management.

traditional.enunciado: What is represented by the word "VPN11" within this JSON schema?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: "VPN11" on the right side of a pair is a JSON value.

traditional.enunciado: Which port type supports the spanning-tree portfast command without additional configuration?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: spanning-tree portfast applies to access ports without the trunk keyword. Trunk edges need portfast trunk; L3 interfaces are not classic STP edge access ports.

traditional.enunciado: What is represented by the word "R29" within this JSON schema?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: "R29" appears as data content on the right-hand side of a JSON pair, so it is a value. Keys are the left-hand property names; objects and arrays are the structural containers.

traditional.enunciado: What is represented in line 2 within this JSON schema?
traditional.explicacao_profunda: A brace-delimited {} block beginning around line 2 is a JSON object containing nested key/value pairs, not a primitive key, value, or array by itself.
